target_customer: Everyday Indian writers and readers of short form poetry, quotes and stories; paying subscribers and book buyers
problem: Regular people had no easy mobile place to publish and monetise short creative writing, as Instagram did for photos.
business_model: Consumer subscriptions and micropayments with 80 percent royalty to writers, plus book publishing and offline events

founders.name: Harsh Snehanshu
founders.background_notes: Inc42 (December 2017) calls both founders IIT Delhi alumni. A search summary of YourStory says earlier products Flatabout and Wherabout were discontinued; that page was not opened.

founders.name: Ashish Singh
founders.background_notes: Press summaries call him CTO; YC page lists him as Founder.

competitors.name: Pratilipi
competitors.what: Vernacular self publishing and reading platform in 12 languages
competitors.traction_then: over 21 million monthly active users in June 2020

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile social app with text to image sharing and payments; server cost was the main strain per YourStory 2020.

defensibility.rationale: A writer community and open mic network gave some pull, but content platforms are easy to copy and Pratilipi was larger.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent bought it; larger platforms kept growing in parallel.

market_need_then: Indian vernacular and short form content use grew fast in 2020; YourQuote claimed profitability since early 2020 and thousands of paying subscriptions.

identity.mascot_or_character: YourQuote Baba, an account that sends writing prompts
identity.visual_style: Quotes rendered as shareable images with a watermark

branding.brand_signature: Watermark on every shared quote image
branding.community_and_virality: Company claimed 300+ open mics in 35 cities by 2017 and about 835 events in 115 cities later (press summary).

brand_strength.rationale: Press describes the YourQuote watermark on every shared post as helping growth, a central persona called YourQuote Baba, and hundreds of offline open mics; reach stayed regional.

pivots.to: Paid stories, subscriptions and book publishing
pivots.why: Monetisation through micropayments reported by Inc42

outcome_analysis: YourQuote raised $1M in 2017, joined YC in Winter 2021 and built a community with offline events and paid stories. The YC directory lists it Inactive, yet a 2025 summary reports FY25 revenue of about Rs 96 lakh and a small profit, so the company may still operate at small scale. No shutdown source was found; the cause of the Inactive flag is not public.
notes: YC says Inactive but the website showed no shutdown notice and an Indian Startup Times item (not opened) reports FY25 revenue; exit left unknown. The 2021 YC round amount is undisclosed; totals across trackers range from $1.0M to $1.13M. Investor lists differ across aggregators. Website fetch returned a cached 2018 era snapshot.
